# Clerk Backend Read API

`clerk-openapi` · openapi · version `2026-08-20` · **published** · readiness `reviewed_publication_user_test_required`

Read-only Clerk Backend API operations for one Clerk application instance. Ragentic exposes GET operations only; the Clerk secret key itself remains a powerful server-side credential and must be protected.
